==Notes==
[[File:Lava Font bug.jpg|thumb|220px|AI using Lava Font out of range]]
*This spell's area of effect is determined when the spell is cast. As such, becoming Overcast while Lava Font is still in effect will not enlarge the area of an already cast font, nor will the spell's area be reduced partway through its duration by the caster's Overcast disappearing.
